messages.en:
Use this to spruce up
your, uh, life! I mean,
only if you want to. You
don't have to or anything.
messages.et:
Kasuta seda oma, ee, elu
kaunistamiseks! Tähendab,
ainult kui tahad. Sa ei
pea seda tegema.

messages.en:
Thanks for your help the
other day! I'd be pleased
if you would accept this
token of my appreciation!
messages.et:
Aitäh abi eest tookord!
Mul oleks hea meel, kui sa
võtaksid vastu selle
tänumärgi!

messages.en:
Your room seems damp.
Why don't you try putting
this in it. I heard it
helps dry out rooms.
messages.et:
Su tuba tundub niiske.
Miks sa ei proovi seda
sinna panna. Kuulsin, et
see kuivatab tube.
